thread:
incident-bot: Paging Maya SRE, on-call. High-severity alert: acme-corp dedicated pool (dedicated-acme-1) experiencing a model quality regression after a quantization profile rollout. Error rate in customer eval suite increased ~18% for top-k outputs.
Maya SRE: I'm on it. Joining. Can someone confirm which profile was rolled to acme? @Jun?
Jun ML: Heads up — we pushed quant profile `q4-aggressive` to acme-corp last night at 02:12 UTC as part of latency/cost trial. Canary showed no perf hit but limited eval set.
Dan Infra: Confirmed deploy log: `deploy/quant-rollout 2026-03-14T02:12Z -> tenant:acme-corp pool:dedicated-acme-1 profile:q4-aggressive` (deploy-bot posted success).
Priya CS: Customer reported degraded answer accuracy around 08:30 their local time. They sent example: hallucinated product prices in 3/5 queries. They're on a queued support plan, CCed exec sponsor. High priority.
Maya SRE: Ok. Impact: single tenant (acme-corp), no global degradation. Plan: revert quant profile to previous `q3-balanced` for tenant immediately, then run diff eval and patch rollback if stable. Need a rollback command and an approval to execute.
Jun ML: Agreed revert. q4 likely over-quantized attention matrices for long-context prompts they use. Reverting should restore quality; expect slight latency increase.
Dan Infra: Command ready for tenant-scoped revert:```
redwoodctl rollout revert --tenant=acme-corp --pool=dedicated-acme-1 --component=quant_profile --from=q4-aggressive --to=q3-balanced --reason="prod_regression_acme" --force
```
Will require `infra-admin` token. I'll stand by to run.
Maya SRE: @Dan run it. I'll monitor metrics and stitch quick smoke tests. Priya, can you prepare a customer-facing note stating we're reverting a performance tweak and will follow up with root cause? Keep it non-technical.
Priya CS: Drafting now. Short note: "We're reverting a recent performance optimization to restore response accuracy for your workload. No data was accessed or changed. We expect normal behavior within minutes and will follow up with details." Send to me for review before I send to acme.
deploy-bot: Action queued: rollback job #rb-8829 created, awaiting operator.
Dan Infra: Executing rollback now. Output: `rollback started -> nodes: 4/4 assigned -> rolling revert`.
Maya SRE: Seeing immediate drops in error rate on eval harness for acme testset. Pre-rollback error 18.7%, post-rollback sample 4.2% (5m window). Latency +10ms p50.
Priya CS: Sent customer note. They replied: "Thanks. Please keep us posted. We need a postmortem and assurance this won't recur."
Maya SRE: Good. Next steps: 1) Collect full diffs (pre/post) and attach eval examples. 2) Jun to run micro-analysis of q4-aggressive failures (attention/kv quant). 3) Dan to record rollout automation gap that allowed tenant direct push without broader eval. 4) Priya to coordinate customer postmortem and share ETA.
Jun ML: I'll run failure repros and push a patch to require conservative thresholds for dedicated tenant rollouts. ETA 48h for root cause analysis, 8h for mitigations (blocklist profile for dedicated pools).
Dan Infra: I'll add a step to the rollout pipeline: require >=3 tenant-specific stress/eval runs or manual approval for dedicated pools. Patch planned in infra backlog, aiming for overnight deploy.
Maya SRE: Handoff: I'm on call for the next 30m to watch for ripple effects, then handing to night oncall (Liam) at 20:00 UTC. Liam, FYI: watch acme metrics and rollback status.
Maya SRE: Adding incident tags: tenant:acme-corp, impact:quality-regression, mitigation:rollback-quant-profile. I'll create an incident doc after stabilizing.
Priya CS: Customer acknowledged and appreciated quick action. I'll schedule a postmortem call with ACME for tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=stabilized, owner=Maya SRE, severity=high, incident_id=INC-20260314-ACME-QREG.
Maya SRE: Closing thread here, moving discussion to incident doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
